sources.snippet: Overview The Conformer class in conformer/model.py24-108 implements the complete Conformer model as described in the paper "Conformer: Convolution-augmented Transformer for Speech Recognition". It acts as the main orchestrator that combines a ConformerEncoder with a final linear classification layer and log-softmax activation.
